comment: Paths that cannot change what the server does with customer data, nor the consent, upload, source, key or account UI in front of it: docs, tests, static media and the public landing, benchmark and changelog pages. Every other tracked path, this file and gate-surface.mjs included, is the gate surface. Shipped code on this list may not fetch, read process.env, use process, globalThis or eval, run on the server-only side, or import supabase, any Node builtin, a package other than react, react-dom, next, next/link and next/image, shared/ gate code or the grant, admission, intake and release-store modules (release-gate-check.test.mjs); that test, its vitest wrapper and the developer setup and safety contract under public/developer/ are surface, so weakening them moves the digest. A symlink or gitlink is surface whatever its name. The production build's first command, node scripts/gate-surface.mjs --deploy, computes the digest before any other repository code runs; next.config.mjs only reads it. What runs after it (pnpm check, the hermetic vitest include of vitest.config.ts, next build) may run surface code and presentational shipped code, and no other presentational code: the last five alwaysSurface rules are that include, and suites that import scripts/repair-scope.mjs are left out of the production prebuild (run-hermetic-vitest.mjs PREBUILD_EXCLUDED_SUITES). Widening this list changes the digest, so it needs a new founder release once. docs/adr/0006-release-continuity-by-gate-surface.md.
